title: 'I AM'
gist: At the burning bush God gives Moses his name, 'I AM WHO AM' (Exodus 3:14). In John's Gospel Jesus says 'I am' with a predicate (the bread of life, the light of the world, the door, the good shepherd, the resurrection, the way, the true vine) and also, strikingly, on its own. His hearers pick up stones: they heard him taking the divine name.
original: Hebrew ehyeh asher ehyeh (Exodus 3:14); Greek ego eimi.

passages.note: 'That you may know... that I am he.'
